title: Workspace ONE to Intune — macOS Device Migration
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (macOS re-enrollment from Workspace ONE incl. ABM re-assignment, profile/shell parity; live-device risk).
hook: Move Macs from Workspace ONE to Intune — re-enrolled with full profile parity
problem: Migrating a Mac fleet off Workspace ONE means moving devices in Apple Business Manager to Intune, re-enrolling, and rebuilding the macOS configuration — settings-catalog policies, custom .mobileconfig profiles, and shell scripts — with the same posture. This solution is the repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune macOS migration: ABM re-assignment, Intune enrollment, profile/shell parity, and a ringed cutover.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the macOS migration model, moving devices in Apple Business Manager to Intune, ADE/Account-driven re-enrollment, rebuilding macOS configuration (settings catalog, custom .mobileconfig, shell scripts) for parity, and the ringed cutover.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Apple Business Manager + the Apple MDM Push (APNs) certificate, Workspace ONE/ABM admin access, the macOS parity target, a pilot group, user comms) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: connect ABM to Intune, build macOS enrollment profiles, reassign devices in ABM, re-enroll by ring, rebuild profile/shell parity, validate, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — macOS migration-readiness discovery, per-device enrollment/parity validation, a migration status and parity report, safe remediation of stuck enrollments, and a migration-ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: The repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune macOS migration — Apple Business Manager re-assignment, Intune enrollment, profile/shell parity, and a ringed cutover. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
